text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened during a volunteer event when 
the members of Muse and I visited a 
pediatric ward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We had planned to chat with the children 
and hold a mini-concert in the hospital 
courtyard, but—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to drop in on you so suddenly. Would 
you mind having a little chat with us?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The story goes back a little while before 
that—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh, is there someone who can't come?

text_block_list.name: Hospital Staff A
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Just this morning, they 
suddenly started saying they didn't want 
to leave their room...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Are you... scared of us, maybe? Rice gets 
nervous meeting people for the first time 
too..."

text_block_list.name: Hospital Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"She was just hospitalized for an injury 
last week... so I'm sure she's feeling 
anxious about a lot of things."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, being hospitalized away from 
their family, they must be feeling lonely 
and down, you know~

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Dragging her out by force might end up 
leaving an emotional scar. If only there 
were a better way...

text_block_list.name: Hospital Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Her parents told me she had enjoyed 
watching the Beauty Dream Cup, so I 
thought that maybe today...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Um... if that's the case, would it be all 
right if I visited her room directly? I'd 
really like to talk with her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You know, we ran in the Beauty Dream Cup! 
Did you watch us?

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: ......Yeah, I saw.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
! Wow, that makes me so happy. How was my 
running?

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text:
“......Um, you see, the outfit is... 
...No, never mind....”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The young girl stammered, looking as 
though she wanted to say something. Just 
as I'd heard, she must admire the Muse. In 
that case—
choice_data_list:
Since you're dressed up, why not show them 
your outfit?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I see, what a wonderful idea♪

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: Wah! A real Muse outfit...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, what do you think? Are we cute?

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Curren-oneechan looks like a 
princess! And Fine-oneechan looks like a 
fairy!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you happen to like fairies? To tell 
you the truth, I came from the land of 
fairies!

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: The land of fairies?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In the country where I was born, 
there were many beautiful forests and 
lakes—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Since long, long ago, humans and fairies 
have lived bustling lives together, 
sometimes quarreling, sometimes joining 
hands.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's why it's the "Fairy Realm"! ♪ 
Though it's far away, it's my precious 
homeland.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text:
"...Big sis Fine, aren't you lonely being 
so far from home?"

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you lonely, not being able to see 
your mom and dad...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I'm not lonely, you know. Because 
not for a single moment do I ever forget 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Look, see this? This Racewear dress holds 
all my deep feelings for my homeland.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I can do my best because there are people 
I hold dear in my heart. Everyone living 
far away is what makes me strong.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You're just like me. You're a strong kid, 
too, fighting through the loneliness of 
missing your parents.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: Am I... strong?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yep♪ She's super strong and such a hard 
worker.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: Strong... and such a hard worker...

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, I... I really do want to see 
the Muse mini-live...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a fun time surrounded by a big 
group of children passed—

text_block_list.name: Hospital Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much for today. All the 
children looked so happy, too..."

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Fine-oneechan.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, did you come to see me off?

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! You know, once I'm discharged, 
I'll come cheer you and the others on at 
your races!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My, then I had better give it my all! I'll 
be eagerly waiting♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The young girl beamed with joy at the 
promise. It seemed Fine Motion had 
completely captured the girl's heart!

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy A
text_block_list.text: Ehhh~, you're going home already~?!

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl B
text_block_list.text:
No, no! Sing one last song for me, 
pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a lovely invitation♪ What do 
you think, Curren-chan?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Since we got an encore, let's respond with 
maximum cuteness♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Returning to the courtyard, Fine Motion 
and the others answered the encore. It 
turned out to be a fulfilling hospital 
visit.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Children
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, big sisters!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I had such a wonderful day. May I visit 
you again sometime?

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy A
text_block_list.text: Really!? That's a promise, okay!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, absolutely♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well then, please excuse me. Thank you 
very much for today♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seen off by the children, the Muses 
successfully concluded their hospital 
visit.
